note: V4 and V5 subjects. The target is the V2 crop (bench/v2/targets/). The painter paints it at width px on a sheet sheetmm wide. medium: the drawing medium a person sees in the target itself: pen (pen-and-ink lines), pencil (faint graphite lines under the paint, no pen) or none (no drawn line). Trumbull is pen: an architectural ink-and-wash study with distinct structural pen contours. Mittens is pencil: the whiskers and hair ends are thin grey lines, lighter than any pen. Sargent and the painted dog show no drawn line.
